# SOL Systems Explorer

SOL Systems Explorer sells one-time interactive technical-explainer templates and custom visualization services.

## Live self-serve products
- SOL Explorer Lite — $29 one-time — simple 2–4 module system explainers — https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/lite.html
- SOL Systems Explorer Starter Kit — $79 one-time — up to 6 modules, live JSON editing, themes, mobile viewer, standalone HTML export — https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/
- SOL Explorer Studio Pack — $199 one-time — up to 12 modules, three layouts, branding controls, reusable client projects — https://klyohojr.github.io/sol-systems-explorer/studio.html

## Live checkout
- Lite: https://buy.stripe.com/00w8wP5x5bDRcRg7HG83C02
- Starter: https://buy.stripe.com/5kQbJ1f7F37l3gGbXW83C01
- Studio: https://buy.stripe.com/bJe5kD0cLeQ3aJ85zy83C03

## Best fit
Hardware startups, engineering consultants, technical visualization studios, industrial designers, technical marketers, educators, robotics, aerospace, energy, and advanced-manufacturing teams.

## Limitations
These products are visualization and technical-communication tools. They are not CAD, engineering simulation, certified digital twins, or safety-critical engineering software.
